arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: fully drawn one-scene storyboard rough for Neet & Buddy Chronicles, not finished art. Show connected neck, shoulder, spine, ribcage, pelvis, four owned limbs, credible floor support and coherent occlusion. Neet is tan/golden-fawn with a very short SMOOTH coat, cream muzzle/chin and irregular chest bib, modest rounded head, projecting tapering muzzle, huge broad-rooted cupped triangular ears, fine long legs below a full narrow torso, a tiny near-flush rump nub only. No long tail, shag, high white socks, black saddle, giant eyes or puppy head. Buddy has a full moderately elongated continuous charcoal close-coated torso, deep chest, visible neck and genuine leg clearance on substantial legs. Modest projecting muzzle, cream moustache/beard, light curved brows, tan chest fields flanking dark throat, pale lower legs/feet, softly pendant ears. No floor-length body shag, square generic terrier, dachshund-short legs or oversized head. Human appearances if visible are provisional story design, no claimed likeness. Actual selected original photographs govern only visible anatomy; generated model supplies provisional pen/wash style, never anatomy authority. Uncalibrated photos establish no fixed proportions/relative scale, weight, ancestry, motion timing, psychology or exact palette. N35 excludes anatomy; B08 styling only and not used; B25 unavailable; B30 supplemental resting evidence only and not used. Multiple encodings of one exposure count once. B04/B24 one exposure, only B04 here. Do not copy photo backgrounds. No costume/collar/extra objects unless specified by actual scene. Draw clear contour/support construction and complete room staging for inspection.
Draw a MONOCHROME staging rough, no watercolor finish yet. Body coats smooth with no long fur hatching; only Buddy face and ears furnished.

Both on simple harnesses with leash clips clearly attached to back harness rings at shoulders, leads extending to cropped human hands at edge; no leash clipped to ears.
